notes.title: Hollow Floor is Out
notes.content:
Finally, after 3 years I have already finished and released my latest challenging Platformer/Metroidvania and released it on Steam and Itch.io. The game is inspired by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/70300/VVVVVV/]VVVVVV[/url] and [url=https://w.itch.io/redder]REDDER[/url] so I would like to thank both Terry Cavanagh and Anna Anthropy for creating my best games. Additional thanks to Shysaur for creating [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/699150/Rex_Another_Island/]Rex Another Island[/url] which introduced me to the amazing musician Pete Gresser who I would to thank deeply for all the help.

The game is out for $3 with 33% off for the release week so you can grab it for $2. The game is also having a demo that you can try and if you like it, consider buying the full game, telling your friends, and reviewing the game on Steam

Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/[/url]

notes.title: Hollow Floor - Demo is out on Steam and Release Date
notes.content:
I hope that you are all alright. I have released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/]Hollow Floor - Demo on Steam[/url]. The steam demo has controller support which was not available before. Similar to the [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/929207]Newgrounds Demo[/url] and [url=https://amidos2006.itch.io/hollow-floor]itch.io Demo[/url], it contains the first powerup, 18 different coins out of the full 99 coins, and 26 rooms out of 104 total rooms.

About the release date, the game is almost done and it is in its final testing phase so finally, a release date is available which is August 27th ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

If you haven't heard about Hollow Floor, It is a small metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. I have been working on it for [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/HollowFloor]multiple years[/url]. Now, try the game and leave comments and feedback :) Also if you enjoyed it please [url= https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/ ]wishlist it on Steam[/url]. I am looking forward to everyone testing the final game when it comes out.

notes.title: Hollow Floor: A single-sitting exploration-based Metroidvania
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I would like to announce my new game Hollow Floor. Hollow Floor is an exploration-based single-sitting Metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. Hollow Floor power-ups are based on adding movesets that will expand the player's ability to explore all three different dangerous biomes. Hollow Floor world is full of secrets and hard challenges that can be tackled at any moment in the game or completely ignored. All you need to finish is to collect any number of power gems to power up the portal and escape this dangerous dimension.

[b]Features:[/b]
- Single-sitting Metroidvania where you can finish it in an hour.
- 99 optional coins to collect which provides extra challenges for challenge seekers.
- Secret passages and shortcuts to explore the whole world.
- A huge world with more than 100 rooms to explore.
- Powerups change the way you play and traverse the full world.
- Three different main biomes that feature different game mechanics and challenges related to them.
- A final biome where the player can test their skills acquired during the previous three biomes.
- Finally, the game doesn't contain any time restrictions which allows for more relaxed play.

Wishlist on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/[/url]
